messages:
Ravi (Finance): Heads-up: BlueForge invoice INV-2026-1602 is 38 days past due. ACH failed this morning. Customer emailed asking for a 4-week deferral + two-installment split. Details below.
BillingBot: Automated alert: ACH return code R01 for INV-2026-1602. Due date: 2026-04-10. Amount: $34,200. https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-1602
Maya (AE): I spoke with their CFO. They request: defer collection activity for 4 weeks, then split remaining balance into 2 equal payments. Onboarding is active and they're asking we avoid suspension while first payment is pending.
Selena (Collections): We can pause external dunning communications internally flagged, but require: signed addendum, autopay or card on file, and first installment authorization prior to pausing suspension. No fee waivers until payment clears.
Harper (Finance Director): Approve conditional deferral: pause outward dunning for 4 weeks, but require first installment (50%) within 3 business days after deferral ends and an authorized payment method now. If first installment fails, immediate suspension and late fees reinstated.
Legal Ops: I'll prepare the short-form addendum with deferral clause and reinstatement language. Need the proposed dates and payment method to insert.
Maya (AE): Customer proposed schedule:
``
INV-2026-1602 total $34,200
Deferral: pause dunning until 2026-05-08
1) $17,100 due 2026-05-11
2) $17,100 due 2026-06-11
Request: pause suspension during deferral and while first payment pending.
``
Selena (Collections): I'll draft the outbound email: attach addendum, require card auth or ACH positive confirmation now, state clear consequence: missed first payment -> same-day hold + reinstatement of fees. Once we have auth, Collections will flip the internal flag to pause external dunning.
Ravi (Finance): Please CC finance on the outgoing. Once first payment clears, I'll move invoice to "on-plan" and update AR and cash forecast. Harper, confirmed we can refund any late fees after clear?
Harper (Finance Director): We can review refunding late fees post-clear on a case-by-case; not automatic. For this account, conditional on timely first payment.
Maya (AE): I'll collect card auth on the 2pm call and post the signed addendum here. Thanks team.
BillingBot: Note: Manual ACH retry recommended only after authorization. Collections flag currently unchanged.
